title: Retry benign stale captures in shared local-tail hydration
outcome: Body-dependent user actions tolerate a bounded number of benign hydration capture races before returning the existing typed retry conflict.
acceptance: A deterministic regression races the first cold-tail capture with an unrelated same-session mutation, then verifies a stable subsequent capture allows the requested body-dependent action without a spurious 409.

Repeated stale captures exhaust a bounded retry policy and preserve LocalSessionTailChanged; corruption and operational failures remain correctly classified, and transcript durability and Stop behavior remain unchanged.
